title: Nuevo Laredo de Mis Amores Turns a Love of History Into a Digital Home for Memories
excerpt: Started by Juan Manuel Herrera in 2017, the Nuevo Laredo de Mis Amores page now has more than 10,000 members sharing old photos and helping identify the people and places in them.
content:
A Facebook page called Nuevo Laredo de Mis Amores has become a gathering place for people who want to keep Nuevo Laredo's history alive, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Juan Manuel Herrera created the page in 2017 to share historical photographs, stories and memories of Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas, and the wider Laredo–Nuevo Laredo border community, the report said. It now has more than 10,000 members and followers.

Members submit photographs, often from family albums, and other members help identify the people, places, businesses, schools and events pictured, according to the Laredo Morning Times. Herrera moderates the page and works to keep submissions focused on the area's history and memories.

Contributors quoted in the report include Gloria Salinas, Maria Angelita Herrera and Jesus Garcia. Members include current and former Nuevo Laredo residents, including people now living in Laredo, Texas, and elsewhere in the United States, as well as people in Mexico, according to the report.

For many, the page is a way to reconnect with childhood places, family members and community history that might otherwise be lost, the report said. No admission fee, event or publication date is stated in the article — the value described by contributors is personal and communal, not commercial.
